discovery_notes: Follow-up to 253 (b079); reuses its keys. 29 standard searches, snippets only. Holds released: WDW50 Mickey & Logo identity (description match), New Asgard ship identity (description match), Up trio format (3-piece pack). Mystery holds kept (Alice, Pumpkin, Fruit, Princess Signature). New: Halloween costume names, Christmas NBC/Cinderella pins, NBC frame series, LSB 3-pin set, NBC train blind box, Chip 'n Dale 50th set, D23 2022 Our Universe pins, Mjolnir doodle, chibi Obi-Wan Padawan, Herc Merch set (held). No Valentine/spring/Pride 2022 BoxLunch pins found.
